scripts.clean: rimraf dist && cd server && npm run clean && cd .. && cd client && npm run clean
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm i && cd server && npm run build && cd .. && cd client && npm run build
scripts.publish: npm run build && cd server && npm run publish && cd .. && cd client && npm run publish
scripts.dev: concurrently -c yellow,blue --names server,client --prefix "{time}-{name}" --pad-prefix "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
